end.summary:
Navya ordered and retold the story using “first, then, at last.”
They answered 2 who/what/where questions correctly.
They practised cap, basket, tree, monkey, sleep, throw, and copy.
Navya corrected the clapping idea and stated that the monkeys copied the cap-seller by throwing their caps.
They identified “took” as the past-tense form for the story.
end.parentNote: Navya practised sequencing, story questions, vocabulary, and past-tense words. Using “first, then, at last” helped them retell all six picture sequences; they also corrected the mix-up about clapping later by explaining that the monkeys threw their caps. At home, ask Navya to retell the story with three picture prompts and the same sequence words.
